design_section: proposals/future-infrastructure.json#FUT-10 §Scope / deliverable and §Acceptance / oracle; designs/federation-infrastructure.md (cloud object storage as an encrypted artifact/backup sink only)
test_oracle: Using synthetic bytes and a fake store: capture every store request and assert it carries ciphertext only, and assert a plaintext upload is refused by default; write two immutable generations and independently restore each one by manifest with exact plaintext hashes; reject a replaced or replayed manifest, a wrong key, a missing generation, and a normal worker principal's list, read, write and delete.
coverage_rationale: RESEARCH/PLANNED: PROPOSED OWNER, PENDING EXPERT REVIEW (scoped source-mapping review recorded on developing-today/code#9155, issuecomment-6909803610, 2026-11-16T07:04:51Z; not an expert-reviewed ruling). ADD-A-023 asks for optional private, tightly scoped, versioned R2 backup research under #9166. FUT-10 (#9166) evaluates exactly that client-encrypted R2 continuity archive with synthetic fixtures and is the acceptance owner. OPS-10 (#9165) is supporting policy only: it is the production approval and legacy-cache boundary, not the owner of the R2 evaluation. Source locator is unchanged: the statement is line 53 of the immutable snapshot (file SHA-256 a84b7885cc6c19707b6ff0a8f77460af06b9c8ad80cd554053f01dc40942ea20); line 54 is only its position in the reformatted sources/ view.
acceptance_enrichment: Prove that each declared scoped role permits only the operations it needs. A fake-store harness policy is not evidence of real R2 enforcement and must not be reported as such.

Model application-level immutable generation IDs and conditional no-overwrite, not native version IDs or multi-object transactions. Cloudflare's S3 compatibility table lists GetBucketVersioning and PutBucketVersioning as unimplemented and documents conditional PutObject headers as evaluated atomically against committed bucket state (https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/, page dated 2026-11-10, read 2026-11-18).
Synthetic fixtures only: no production R2 account, bucket, credentials, keys, configuration, or escrow authorization.
